description: Light canvas; blackboard-style framed board upper with black-ink Hubble drawing tilted, pencil/chalk tray below; stick figure lower-left holding a sheet of paper. No text.
Single frame: curved Earth limb with atmosphere arcs appears at right inside the board. Hubble and figure unchanged.
Same board with Hubble at left and Earth arc at right; stick figure with paper lower-left.
Hard cut to black starfield: Hubble drawing left with tiny label 'WIDE FIELD PLANETARY CAMERA 2 (WFPC2)' (small text), grey-shaded Earth right-centre, small Moon icon upper-right. Layout is portrait.
Black starfield; Hubble with WFPC2 label, Earth, Moon icon upper right. No title text.
White hand-lettered text types on above Hubble ('Tl' then 'TOO SLOW'); a curved arrow pointing from the text to the Hubble body then appears. Scene otherwise static.
Black starfield; 'TOO SLOW' with curved arrow over Hubble; Earth and Moon icon right.

Hard cut to white canvas with tiny Hubble at far left trailing long thin lines to right edge (blurred at onset). Over the activity frames a faint grey ghost Hubble stays upper-left with horizontal line while the black Hubble translates down-left and its ray rotates upward, with grey wedge and short horizontal reference line. Onset cut identified at f183 only; exact timing of the motion start UNRESOLVED.
White canvas: grey ghost Hubble upper-left with horizontal grey line right; black Hubble lower-left with rising grey ray to right edge and small grey wedge.
Canvas slides left with blur: Hubbles slide off left edge, lines streak, then a sketchy black-ink spiral galaxy appears at right-centre sitting at ray ends.
White canvas: thin grey lines from left converging on a stippled black-ink spiral galaxy right-centre.
Canvas slides back: galaxy exits right, Hubbles re-enter left (ghost upper, black lower) and a grey Moon circle with arrow and label 'MOON' appears on the upper line.
Ghost Hubble upper-left, grey Moon circle with up-arrow and 'MOON' on upper line; black Hubble lower-left with grey ray and wedge.

Layout rescales: Hubble and Moon drift smaller/left; ray and wedge turn red and the ray rotates slightly steeper over the frames. Details between f327 and f343 blurry at tile scale; exact scale change UNRESOLVED.
Ghost Hubble upper-left, Moon with 'MOON' label, black Hubble lower-left with red ray and red wedge.
Dashed vertical line draws top-down at right crossing the red ray; small label types on left of it, line by line: 'AUTOMATIC ON-BOARD TRACKING ALGORITHM LIMIT'.
Dashed vertical line with 'AUTOMATIC ON-BOARD TRACKING ALGORITHM LIMIT' right; Moon label now reads 'MOON (TOO CLOSE)'. Encoder artifact frames noted but no visible change.

Canvas slides right with motion blur; a vertical divider line and a NASA-desk scene enter from left: 'MANUAL TRACKING' label, stick figure with item, seated woman at desk with monitor and NASA logo. Moon label changes from 'MOON (TOO CLOSE)' back to 'MOON'; algorithm-limit label slides off right.
Left of divider: 'MANUAL TRACKING' label, standing stick figure with small object, seated woman at NASA-logo desk with monitor. Right: ghost Hubble, 'MOON', black Hubble with red ray and grey wedge.

Hubble rotates stepwise counter-clockwise from lower angle to steeper, red wedge widens and ray ends on the Moon; the seated woman changes pose slightly; Moon becomes filled grey circle and arrow label drops. Canvas translates slightly right then settles.
Hubble rotated steeply, red wedge with red ray ending at grey Moon; manual-tracking scene left unchanged except woman faces other way.
Hard cut to black photo plate: grey mosaic photograph of lunar craters (upper) beside a Moon photo (right) with a fan of lines; tiny caption text under both, unreadable at tile scale.
Black canvas: grey lunar mosaic upper-left, round Moon photo right, tiny captions, unreadable at tile scale.
Hard cut to full-frame colour nebula photo (blue/magenta/red shell around bright white core on black starfield) with tiny caption lower-left, unreadable at tile scale.
Colour nebula photo with starfield and tiny caption lower-left, unreadable at tile scale.

Hard cut to white canvas: Hubble upper-right-centre, grey vertical line and red tilted line to lower-left desk chair; red curved arrow between them; two desks with chairs at bottom (left chair dark blue with blur trail, right grey), ground line. No text yet.
Hubble upper centre; red tilted ray to left chair on desk with motion-blur trail; grey vertical ray to right chair; red curved arrow; no label.
Single frame: title 'EXPECTATION' and red label '~1°/second' appear on the arrow; layout same as previous hold.
'EXPECTATION' title top; Hubble; red tilted ray to left chair; red '~1°/second' with curved arrow; ground line and two desks.
Cross-dissolve: 'EXPECTATION' to 'REALITY', Hubble tilt eases upright, red ray swings near vertical, '~1°/second' to '6°/minute' with small arrow.
'REALITY' title; Hubble upper with near-vertical red ray; red '6°/minute' label with arrow; two desks with chairs, left one blurred.
Hard cut to blank white canvas with only a tilted black-ink Hubble centre.
White canvas; single tilted Hubble drawing centre.
Single frame: Hubble drawing larger and shifted; a mechanical contraption with gears and tiny bicycle-like shapes appears at its upper-left end.
Enlarged Hubble with gear/chain contraption attached at upper-left; black ink only.
Single frame: tiny stick figure with tool appears above the Hubble near the contraption; Hubble slightly shifted left/up.
Hubble with gear contraption and small stick figure atop; white background, black ink.
Single frame: black-ink Earth limb with dashed atmosphere arcs and continents appears lower-right.
Hubble with contraption and figure left; Earth outline lower-right.
Speech-bubble with zigzag tail grows from Hubble front: small bordered photo panel with a tan board and blue round object, scaling up from a tiny speck to mid-size.
Speech-bubble photo (tan board with items, blue round object) to right of Hubble; Earth lower-right.
Camera zooms in on speech bubble: Hubble and Earth blur out lower-left, bubble border enlarges and exits, photo fills the canvas blurred.
Zoomed blurry photo: tan board with items upper, blue round top-down object below, white background.

Blue top-down object with legs rotates and swings left-down over the frames (spinning chair seen from above); then canvas zooms out until the photo shrinks to a small bordered panel at right-centre. Exact rotation timing between tiles UNRESOLVED.
Small bordered photo panel at right (tan board, blue chair); white canvas otherwise.
Single frame: black silhouette of Hubble at left struck with banner 'REDACTED' (white all-caps on black, tilted) and speech-bubble frame with zigzag tail around the photo.
Black redacted Hubble with 'REDACTED' banner; bubble with photo upper right.
Single frame: black-ink Earth outline appears lower-right; REDACTED Hubble shifts down-left.
REDACTED Hubble left, speech bubble with photo upper right, Earth lower-right.
Single frame: small striped flag graphic appears on the redacted Hubble body upper-left; small change, lowish confidence.
Redacted Hubble with small striped flag, 'REDACTED' banner, photo bubble upper right, Earth lower-right.
